{{Top|leg}}
The '''Galactic Universal Translator''' or '''GalUT''' was a program that was installed on the [[MicroData Technologies/Legends|MicroData Technologies]] [[Companion2000]] [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]]. It would analyze unknown computer systems and develop a protocol for interpreting and transferring data between the [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] to the new computer.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
